blocks.text: Coquitlam East Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: The one part of this page that can be bounded from a City plan is Austin Heights, on either side of Austin Avenue.

The Austin Heights Neighbourhood Plan (AHNP) area runs roughly from Foster Avenue in the north to Rochester Avenue in the south, and from Blue Mountain Street and Joyce Street in the west to Linton Street in the east.
The City calls Austin Heights the first neighbourhood centre east of the Lougheed urban centre, roughly north of the Maillardville Neighbourhood Centre.
The wider board name Coquitlam East has no City-published boundary, so a listing's sub-area label is not a plan boundary;.

blocks.text: Coquitlam East Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Houses are the main land use here, because the plan says the existing small-scale residential areas are the largest land use element in Austin Heights and are to be respected.

The plan's growth pattern puts medium-density housing close to the Austin Avenue centre as a buffer, with ground-oriented housing in attached or detached form beyond it, so detached lots sit mostly off the Austin Avenue core.
No City, School District No.

blocks.text: Coquitlam East Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The Austin Heights plan, not the board label, is the rulebook for these lots, and it now sits as Schedule J-1 of the Interim Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw No. 5511, 2026.
The plan requires new medium-density development near the centre to transition in massing to the lower-density houses beside it, respecting slope, privacy and building massing.

blocks.text: Coquitlam East Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Austin Avenue is part of TransLink's regional Major Road Network, so it carries regional traffic through the middle of this house area, and the plan's road work aims to keep that role while improving the pedestrian experience.
The plan protects the Poirier Leisure Precinct south of the plan area as an area-wide recreation resource and commits the City to master-plan it, which is the recreation anchor for these houses.
The nearest library branch for most of these streets is the Coquitlam Public Library Poirier branch at 575 Poirier Street; the City Centre branch is at 1169 Pinetree Way.
Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way in Port Moody, is the Fraser Health hospital on the Port Moody and Coquitlam border serving this side of the city.

blocks.text: Coquitlam East Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Austin Heights Neighbourhood Plan implementation, Austin Avenue between Blue Mountain Street and Linton Street, City of Coquitlam plan in the Interim Official Community Plan (OCP): the plan directs an Austin Avenue streetwall podium with towers between Blue Mountain and Gatensbury streets, retail at grade and homes above — STATUS: adopted plan policy, read 2026-11-03.

blocks.text: Coquitlam East Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: The house-specific point is that Coquitlam bills a separate drainage rate inside the total residential rate, which matters on larger sloped lots with more runoff.

blocks.text: Coquitlam East Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check slope first on these lots, using the City's environmental development permit mapping, which maps unstable slopes and watercourse areas; the map shows the layer, not a lot-level geotechnical answer.
Check any creek on or beside the lot against the Watercourse Protection Development Permit rules before assuming a suite or carriage house fits.
Check the Zoning Bylaw No. 3000, 1996 flood and slope siting rules in Part 5 for any lot at the foot of the slope toward the Brunette lowlands.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Coquitlam East

East of Mundy Park, out toward the former Riverview lands and the Port Coquitlam side, Coquitlam East is an established detached area. Mundy Park is at one edge, and Coquitlam Central Station is the nearest rapid-transit link.
Coquitlam East home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

48 houses sold in Coquitlam East with a median price of $1,702,450 (the middle half sold between $1,470,000 and $1,902,500), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $509 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 7,398 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Coquitlam East?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 27 houses listed in Coquitlam East. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Coquitlam East a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Coquitlam East had a sales ratio of 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Coquitlam East from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 23 houses sold in Coquitlam East over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Coquitlam East?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Is my house inside the Austin Heights plan area?
faq.a: Check the street, not the listing label. The plan area runs on either side of Austin Avenue, roughly Foster Avenue north to Rochester Avenue south, and Blue Mountain Street and Joyce Street west to Linton Street east. A house inside those lines is read against the Austin Heights Neighbourhood Plan as well as the city-wide Official Community Plan (OCP).

faq.q: Which schools sit on or beside these streets?
faq.a: Mundy Road Elementary is at 2200 Austin Avenue, on Austin Avenue itself, and École Rochester Elementary is at 411 Schoolhouse Street, with École Montgomery Middle at 1900 Edgewood Avenue. Those are locations, not assignments: School District No.

faq.q: Will the Austin Avenue core change my side street?
faq.a: The plan aims the change at the core, not the side streets. It transitions the commercial core to a high-density mixed-use area, adds medium-density housing next to it as a buffer, and keeps small-scale residential as part of the mix, so a detached lot two blocks off Austin Avenue is planned differently from one on it.

The mapped river floodplains are the lowlands, not this slope. The City's floodplain mapping covers the Coquitlam, Fraser and Pitt rivers, while Austin Heights sits on the slope above the Brunette and Fraser lowlands; the local check for a house lot here is slope and any creek on or beside the lot, through the City's development permit mapping.

faq.q: What did houses in Coquitlam East sell for?
faq.a: 48 houses sold in Coquitlam East between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,702,450.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Coquitlam East?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
